t: Four number pairs are given, three following the same rule. Select the odd one: A) 344 – 18 B) 289 – 17 C) 256 – 16 D) 169 – 13

t: Four number pairs are given, three following the same rule. Select the odd one: A) 13 - 225 B) 11 - 169 C) 15 - 289 D) 17 - 381

t: In three of the following pairs the pattern is the same except one. Which pair does not follow the pattern? A) 8,27 B) 64,125 C) 50,125 D) 216,343

t: In three of the following pairs the pattern is the same except one. Which pair does not follow the pattern? A) 36:64 B) 25:36 C) 9:16 D) 16:25
